parent.notes: Adds an SOS notification and Children tab ordering. The app reads the SOS alerts recorded on the server, so an SOS is not missed when a normal location report arrives right after it, and shows one urgent notification per SOS, also when the app is closed and background alerts are on. On the Children tab the child who pressed SOS last is shown first and the one before second. Includes the pre-filled server address from v1.4.16. Login, billing and all other features are unchanged. Signed ARM + ARM64 APK after successful static analysis and tests. No phone testing claimed.

client.notes: Adds 32-bit ARM support. Previous APKs lacked the 32-bit Flutter engine and app library; this may explain launch failure on 32-bit Android. All features are unchanged from v24 (source diff: build and version files only). Retest pending on a 32-bit phone. Signed ARM + ARM64 + x86-64 APK after successful static analysis and tests. Not tested on a physical phone.

tiffe_staff.notes:
Tiffe Staff 1.0.11: in-app updates that finish.
Updates now download from a mirror that works on networks that block GitHub downloads, with GitHub as a backup. If a download stops moving for 15 seconds, the app switches to the next address. If every address fails, it shows the reason and a Retry button instead of sitting at 0.0 MB.
Everything from 1.0.10 is unchanged: light mode, the Updates button next to Sync, readable handover, Accept Order and Remove bhaji.
Not tested on a phone. Analyze, the full test suite and the signed build passed in CI before publishing.

tiffe.notes: In-app updates now download reliably. The update downloads from a mirror that works on networks that block GitHub downloads, with GitHub as a backup. If a download stops moving for 15 seconds the app switches to the next address, and if every address fails it shows the reason and a Retry button instead of sitting at 0.0 MB. Order alerts at every step with the app closed, from 1.0.57, are unchanged. Not phone-tested.
